study type: Cross-sectional survey with retrospective data collection
cohort: The study participants were 1200 post-menopausal women living in Plaza de la Revolucion, a municipality of Havana, Cuba.
finding: The mean pregnancy rate was 3.81 pregnancies per woman, but the live birth rate was only 1.89 due to a high abortion rate (40% of all pregnancies), indicating abortion was used as a method of birth control.
cross-section timing: Data collected from post-menopausal women's entire reproductive histories up to the time of the survey (published 2014).
